facts.business: QGO Finance Limited is a Base Layer NBFC (Category B) providing Cooperative Housing Society Loans, Project Loans, Business Loans, Retail Loans, Loan Against Property, and co-lending partnerships without accepting public deposits.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The company is looking into co-lending activities being a substantial part of their lending business in the future.

auditor.name: M/s. R C Reshamwala & Co., Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: During the year the Company has started a new lending activity and has partnered with another company to foray into co-lending activities. The company is looking into this being a substantial part of their lending business in the future. (Refer to Note no. 57)

key_risks: New co-lending activity and partnership risk
Dependence on refinancing with larger NBFCs
